instruction: Candid outdoor medium shot of a couple in a snowy forest. On the right, the woman in the grey beanie (R1) stands in a black leather jacket, holding a black dog and kissing its snout with closed eyes. On the left, the man in the brown coat (R2), wearing a black beanie, leans forward to kiss the dog's head. They stand close together on a snow-covered path, sharing a warm moment in the cold winter setting. Soft, diffused winter daylight illuminates the scene, creating a cool-toned palette with warm brown and beige accents.
elements: R1 holds and supports the black dog while kissing its snout
R2 leans forward to kiss the dog's head instead of holding the dog
R1 is the person carrying the dog, not R2
